Use the table as a state model. An ordinary note or work log can append history without a state change. Resolution means the technician reports completion. Closure means the resident has accepted it. In this browser edition the timeline is not protected from direct browser-storage editing.

This is the actual project case study requested by the user, not an invented study of another company. Common pitfalls include vague acceptance criteria, overlooked stakeholder roles, undocumented changes, tool adoption without need, and mistaking a successful UI demonstration for complete quality assurance. Best practices connect each change to rationale, evidence and remaining risk.
